items.quote: Jose did a great job replacing our outdoor light fixture. The new light look fantastic and were installed cleanly and professionally. He was reliable, efficient, and paid attention to the details. I’m very happy with the finished result and would definitely recommend Jose to anyone needing work done around their home.

Beyond impress with the service that Jose provided. I called him for help installing our dryer, and he was at our house the same-day within 30 minutes. He was very professional and knowledgeable and gave us good advice on how to maintain our dryer going forward. Highly recommend Jose for any handyman needs.

Jose is a great guy and does solid work. He showed up when he said he would, got everything done the right way, and didn’t cut corners. His prices were fair, he was easy to work with, and the quality was better than I expected.
